propositions: The retired trigger word 'recheck-review' is a substring of the external CI mapping 'recheck', causing substring-based ChatOps matching to dispatch unintended Verified workflows when the bot comments contain that word
The new trigger token 'rerun-llm-review' shares no substring with any [mapping "comment-added"] key in the ini template, preventing the collision
All bot-posted reply texts must be scrubbed of mapped trigger words, including _ACCEPTED_MESSAGE and _refusal_message, since Gerrit comments from the bot itself become sources of re-dispatch
The retired word triggers a refusal reply naming the new trigger and never enqueues a review or writes a label
Documentation, guides, and runbooks must be updated to instruct only the new trigger word; the retired word survives in source only within retrigger.py and its test module
